description: Cost inputs NOT captured in per-part price_usd. Total system cost for a combination = sum(part.price_usd x quantity) + these adders, x contingency. Quantities come from the solved metrics (panels_needed, battery_blocks_needed). All USD, approximate — verify. Parts with no price_usd (e.g. quote-only) make a combination's cost unknown, and it is excluded from ranking.

balance_of_system.definition: Fuses (Class-T + string), DC breakers, disconnects, busbars.

wiring.definition: Battery cables, PV wire, MC4, lugs.

bms_per_battery_string.definition: Added per series string for DIY cells, or per module whose bms field is 'needed'. Packs with integrated BMS add nothing.

contingency_factor.definition: Multiplier on (parts + adders) for misc/small parts/overage.
